transcription: Verdicts and corrected fields copied verbatim from the verificador's final message; reasons condensed by the build session.

verdicts.reason: Objective sentence (series-wide wording, ambiguous at most). The quote ended with a dangling ' [...]'; replaced by the full sentence.

corrected.quote: The objectives of this investigation were to: (1) determine how rapidly a large scale fire grows in low-gravity and (2) investigate the low-g flammability limits compared to those obtained in NASA’s normal gravity material flammability screening test.
corrected.derivation: Objective statement, not a statement of the test condition. The JSON field has line breaks after 'to:' and after 'normal', each joined with one space. Source term 'low-gravity'; no g-level stated; mapped to the controlled term microgravity. The same objective wording is in the Objectives PDF abstract (page 1), which covers Saffire-I, -II and -III; page 3 assigns objective (2) to Saffire-II.

verdicts.reason: Verbatim at paragraph=1; an objective covering SAFFIRE-I and -III; ambiguous and SHARED_LINEAGE correct.
Verbatim on Operations PDF page 1; purpose clause for Saffire-I and -III; ambiguous is the ceiling.
Verbatim at section=researchImpacts; impact summary, not a test condition; ambiguous. Recommends SHARED_LINEAGE.
Verbatim at section=approach, names Saffire-I; fabric -> solid is a correct derivation.
Verbatim, past tense, names Saffire-1 on the Cygnus vehicle; survived the negative control.
Verbatim hardware label; same record as R6, not independent.

flightProgram 'International Space Station (ISS)' is a program label; the burn ran on Cygnus after it left the ISS (section=approach; Operations PDF page 1). Recording ISS would put Saffire with in-station experiments.
Verbatim at section=approach; air -> N2 is a correct one-line derivation. No allowed document states Saffire-I O2.
Results sentence covers the large Saffire-I/III sample; the Cygnus bridge in the derivation is not on the slide.

corrected.derivation: derived: slide 18 ('Saffire-I-III Results', Urban et al., ASGSR 2017, NTRS 20180005168) says 'low-gravity' about the large thin charring surface. Slides 14/23/30 identify that sample as the 40.6 x 94 cm cotton-fiberglass of Saffire-I (I-1) and Saffire-III. The same deck labels these burns 'µ-g' (slide 31) and 'microgravity' (slide 17). The deck reports Saffire-I and III together, so it is not independent per flight (SHARED_LINEAGE). The deck does not itself tie 'low-gravity' to Cygnus in one sentence.

NTRS slide 31 headers 'µ-g Burn Length ...' with rows 1-1, 1-2 (Saffire-I) are a per-sample alternative.
